releases.title: Touch controls, calmer Floor 998 and more
notes: On phones, the on-screen controls for moving, dodging and dashing now show up as they should.
The skip button on the death screen is much bigger and easy to hit with a thumb.
Floor 998, The Spill, is calmer, and the hero gets a few seconds of invincibility when it starts.
Ghosts of players who have stepped away look fainter, and the main menu now has a band of climbing ghosts with a "climbing right now" label.

releases.title: Grapple hook, ghosts and new moves
notes: A grapple hook joins the climb, along with moving platforms, wind and gravity flips on the higher floors.
The hero has new animations for dashing, wall sliding, wall jumping, shooting on the run, and punching with bare fists.
Other players on your floor now appear as pale ghosts of the hero.
Rewinding a dash now returns the hero exactly to where he started.
A loading bar shows while a floor loads, and the level select is split into pages.

releases.title: Settings, video and jumping updates
notes: The Settings screen now opens and is visible from the main menu.
A new video explains how the hero ended up in Hell.
Jumping works reliably on uneven ground.
Yooba's shop no longer overlaps its subtitle and footnote when it has seven goods.

releases.title: Rewind, shop and prologue updates
notes: Rewinding out of a death now returns you to a safe moment instead of putting you straight back into the hit.
Every item in Yooba's shop now shows its price and Buy button, including the last one.
Yooba's portrait no longer covers the shop title, and the subtitle now appears once.
The shop title is no longer cut off by the 'NO TABS!' starburst.
The portal prologue now includes all of the hero's reactions, and the Shaft screen no longer shows doubled text.

releases.title: Clearer titles on the HUD and menus
notes: Titles on the HUD and in menus now have more room on the right edge, so they no longer press against the screen edge.
Titles on the HUD and in menus are also higher contrast, so they're easier to read at a glance.

releases.title: Launch trailer and crisper art
notes: The Sick Of It launch trailer is now on the home page, so you can watch it without leaving the site.
The Overlord, Bork and the fireball art on the home page now look sharper and come alive with animation.

releases.title: Smoother rewinds and sharper aim
notes: Rewinding time now runs smoothly, even deep into a long climb.
The aim laser now follows your real shot path, including upgraded shots.
The mouse cursor is now a crosshair that fits Hell's style.
Restarting a level now really starts it over from the beginning.

releases.title: The climb is open
notes: Hell has 1,000 floors. You have a rewind button. Good luck.
Rewind time when a run goes wrong, which it will.
Install it for offline play, so Hell can come with you.
